description: Source code for the PortGuardian actor class in Swift, which manages network port monitoring, process tracking, and related diagnostics for the OpenClaw application.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing network ports, process monitoring, and diagnostics related to port usage in the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Performs a network port sweep and terminates unexpected listeners based on the mode.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records information about a port and its associated process, then saves the record.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes records associated with a specific process ID.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Generates diagnostic reports about port listening statuses.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the gateway service on a specified port.

methods.name: isListening
methods.description: Checks if a specific port (optionally with a specific process ID) is being listened to.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides details about the process listening on a given port.
